cond_0001.intro:
Under the direction of the principal investigator, the research project coordinator assists in coordinating [Company name masked]'s participation in a national collaborative quality improvement (QI) network called ImproveCareNow. This QI network involves a registry designed to study, understand, and improve patient care of children with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), a collection of chronic diseases that cause inflammation of the digestive or gastrointestinal tract. The selected candidate will interact with and enter data into this national QI registry, as well as coordinate other related projects.
Responsibilities span many aspects of study design and network collaboration, and may include: coordinating the collection of data and informed consent, interacting with the Institutional Review Board (IRB), assisting in the preparation of presentations, contributing to discussions within [Company name masked] and the national QI network, and effectively gathering, entering, and analyzing accurate data from patient charts.
This position is a good fit for someone looking to develop a career in medicine, public health, and/or quality improvement.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Coordinates data collection from clinic visits
Extracts patient information from medical records
Manages data entry and maintenance of study records
Communicates effectively with various care providers, clinical support staff, research staff, QI consultants, and other collaborators
Assists in regulatory documentation and development of protocols
Participates in the recruitment of patients
Facilitates and participates in QI activities
Prepares QI reports
Provides positive and effective customer service that supports departmental and hospital operations
Contributes to teamwork within and between departments and organizations
Prepares agendas and runs weekly project team meetings
Works with interns and/or students on the team
Represents the team on calls/webinars and at bi-annual network conferences
Performs other related duties as assigned
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree, preferably in the biological or health sciences, or related field
Critical attention to detail and accuracy
Computer skills, including fluency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Strong writing and analytical skills
Well-organized with exceptional interpersonal skills, as interaction with patients, families, medical staff, and other researchers is necessary
Preferred Requirements
Biostatistical skills and knowledge of basic data management software (SPSS, MS)
Prior healthcare experience
Coursework in the biological or social sciences

cond_0087.intro:
Under the direction of the principal investigator, the research project coordinator helps coordinate [Company name masked]'s participation in a national collaborative quality improvement (QI) network called ImproveCareNow. This QI network involves a registry designed to study, understand, and improve patient care of children with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), a collection of chronic diseases that cause inflammation of the digestive or gastrointestinal tract. The selected candidate will regularly interact with and enter data into this national QI registry, as well as coordinate other related projects.
Responsibilities span many aspects of study design and network collaboration, and may include: coordinating the collection of data and informed consent, staying in contact with the Institutional Review Board (IRB), assisting in the preparation of presentations, actively contributing to discussions within [Company name masked] and the national QI network, and effectively gathering, entering, and analyzing accurate data from patient charts. This role involves regular interaction with many different types of providers and other staff involved in healthcare.
The selected candidate must be well-organized, enthusiastic, and professional. The candidate must also be independent, efficient, and have strong interpersonal skills, as ongoing interaction with patients, families, medical staff, and other researchers is a central part of the work. This work requires the level of knowledge acquired through completion of a bachelor's degree. Prior healthcare experience is a plus. Coursework in the biological or social sciences is recommended, and strong writing and analytical skills are required. This position is a good fit for someone seeking to develop a career in medicine, public health, and/or quality improvement.

Under the direction of the principal investigator, the research project coordinator assists in coordinating [Company name masked]'s participation in a national collaborative quality improvement (QI) network called ImproveCareNow. This QI network involves a registry designed to study, understand, and improve patient care of children with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), a collection of chronic diseases that cause inflammation of the digestive or gastrointestinal tract. The selected candidate will interact with and enter data into this national QI registry, as well as coordinate other related projects.
Responsibilities span many aspects of study design and network collaboration, and may include: coordinating the collection of data and informed consent, interacting with the Institutional Review Board (IRB), assisting in the preparation of presentations, contributing to discussions within [Company name masked] and the national QI network, and effectively gathering, entering, and analyzing accurate data from patient charts. The work for this project takes place in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with opportunities to interact with many different types of providers and other staff involved in healthcare.
The selected candidate must be highly motivated, well-organized, enthusiastic, and professional. The candidate must also be independent, efficient, and have exceptional interpersonal skills, as interaction with patients, families, medical staff, and other researchers is necessary. This work requires the level of knowledge acquired through completion of a bachelor's degree. Prior healthcare experience is a plus. Coursework in the biological or social sciences is recommended, and strong writing and analytical skills are required. This position is wonderful for an individual seeking to develop a career in medicine, public health, and/or quality improvement.
cond_0111.responsibilities:
Coordinates data collection from clinic visits
Extracts patient information from medical records
Manages data entry and maintenance of study records
Communicates effectively with various care providers, clinical support staff, research staff, QI consultants, and other collaborators
Assists in regulatory documentation and development of protocols
Participates in the recruitment of patients
Facilitates and participates in QI activities
Prepares QI reports
Provides positive and effective customer service that supports departmental and hospital operations
Contributes to teamwork within and between departments and organizations
Prepares agendas and runs weekly project team meetings
Works with interns and/or students on the team
Represents the team on calls/webinars and at bi-annual network conferences
Performs other related duties as assigned
cond_0111.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in the biological or health sciences, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Attention to detail and accuracy
Working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Ability to commit to at least one year
Preferred Requirements
Background in biostatistics or familiarity with basic data management software (SPSS, MS)
Prior healthcare experience

cond_0134.intro:
Under the direction of the principal investigator, the research project coordinator leads coordination of [Company name masked]'s participation in a national collaborative quality improvement (QI) network called ImproveCareNow. This QI network involves a registry designed to study, understand, and improve patient care of children with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), a collection of chronic diseases that cause inflammation of the digestive or gastrointestinal tract. The selected candidate will own data entry into this national QI registry and drive other related projects forward.
Responsibilities span many aspects of study design and network collaboration, and may include: leading the collection of data and informed consent, engaging directly with the Institutional Review Board (IRB), taking ownership of presentation preparation, contributing to discussions within [Company name masked] and the national QI network, and independently gathering, entering, and analyzing accurate data from patient charts.

This QI network involves a registry designed to study, understand, and improve patient care of children with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), a collection of chronic diseases that cause inflammation of the digestive or gastrointestinal tract. The selected candidate will interact with and enter data into this national QI registry, as well as coordinate other related projects.
Responsibilities span many aspects of study design and network collaboration, and may include: coordinating the collection of data and informed consent, interacting with the Institutional Review Board (IRB), assisting in the preparation of presentations, contributing to discussions within [Company name masked] and the national QI network, and effectively gathering, entering, and analyzing accurate data from patient charts.
This position is a good fit for someone seeking to develop a career in medicine, public health, and/or quality improvement.
cond_0191.responsibilities:
Coordinates data collection from clinic visits
Extracts patient information from medical records
Manages data entry and maintenance of study records
Communicates effectively with various care providers, clinical support staff, research staff, QI consultants, and other collaborators
Assists in regulatory documentation and development of protocols
Participates in the recruitment of patients
Facilitates and participates in QI activities
Prepares QI reports
Provides positive and effective customer service that supports departmental and hospital operations
Contributes to teamwork within and between departments and organizations
Prepares agendas and runs weekly project team meetings
Works with interns and/or students on the team
Represents the team on calls/webinars and at bi-annual network conferences
Performs other related duties as assigned
cond_0191.requirements:
Bachelor's degree required, preferably in the biological or health sciences or a related field; advanced degree strongly preferred
Demonstrated expertise in critical attention to detail and accuracy
Strong command of Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint required
Proficiency in biostatistical methods and solid understanding of basic data management software (SPSS, MS) strongly preferred
Proven ability to work independently, with exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively with patients, families, medical staff, and researchers
Substantial prior healthcare experience preferred
Advanced knowledge of biological or social sciences, with strong writing and analytical skills required
Ability to commit to at least one year
cond_0191.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0191.values: We value work that is useful to others and carried out with care. We believe strong organizations pay attention not only to outcomes, but also to how those outcomes affect people.

cond_0292.intro:
Under the direction of the principal investigator, the research project coordinator assists in coordinating [Company name masked]'s participation in a national collaborative quality improvement (QI) network called ImproveCareNow. This QI network involves a registry designed to study, understand, and improve patient care of children with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), a collection of chronic diseases that cause inflammation of the digestive or gastrointestinal tract. The selected candidate will interact with and enter data into this national QI registry, as well as coordinate other related projects.
Responsibilities span many aspects of study design and network collaboration, and may include: coordinating the collection of data and informed consent, interacting with the Institutional Review Board (IRB), assisting in the preparation of presentations, contributing to discussions within [Company name masked] and the national QI network, and effectively gathering, entering, and analyzing accurate data from patient charts.
The selected candidate must be well-organized, enthusiastic, and professional. The candidate must also be independent, efficient, and have exceptional interpersonal skills, as interaction with patients, families, medical staff, and other researchers is necessary. This position is a good fit for someone looking to develop a career in medicine, public health, and/or quality improvement. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of clinical data and quality improvement work.
cond_0292.responsibilities:
Coordinates data collection from clinic visits
Extracts patient information from medical records
Manages data entry and maintenance of study records
Communicates effectively with various care providers, clinical support staff, research staff, QI consultants, and other collaborators
Assists in regulatory documentation and development of protocols
Participates in the recruitment of patients
Facilitates and participates in QI activities
Prepares QI reports
Provides positive and effective customer service that supports departmental and hospital operations
Contributes to teamwork within and between departments and organizations
Prepares agendas and runs weekly project team meetings
Works with interns and/or students on the team
Represents the team on calls/webinars and at bi-annual network conferences
Performs other related duties as assigned
cond_0292.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree, preferably in the biological or health sciences, or related field
Critical attention to detail and accuracy
Computer skills, including fluency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Ability to commit to at least one year
Preferred Requirements
Biostatistical skills and knowledge of basic data management software (SPSS, MS)
Prior healthcare experience
Coursework in the biological or social sciences
Strong writing and analytical skills

This QI network involves a registry designed to study, understand, and improve patient care of children with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), a collection of chronic diseases that cause inflammation of the digestive or gastrointestinal tract. The selected candidate will interact with and enter data into this national QI registry, as well as coordinate other related projects.
Responsibilities span many aspects of study design and network collaboration, and may include: coordinating the collection of data and informed consent, interacting with the Institutional Review Board (IRB), assisting in the preparation of presentations, contributing to discussions within [Company name masked] and the national QI network, and effectively gathering, entering, and analyzing accurate data from patient charts.
The selected candidate must be well-organized, enthusiastic, and professional. The candidate must also be independent, efficient, and have exceptional interpersonal skills, as interaction with patients, families, medical staff, and other researchers is necessary. This position is a good fit for someone seeking to develop a career in medicine, public health, and/or quality improvement. People tend to become stronger in this kind of research coordination work over time as they build experience and learn from the teams and providers they work with.
cond_0374.responsibilities:
Coordinates data collection from clinic visits
Extracts patient information from medical records
Manages data entry and maintenance of study records
Communicates effectively with various care providers, clinical support staff, research staff, QI consultants, and other collaborators
Assists in regulatory documentation and development of protocols
Participates in the recruitment of patients
Facilitates and participates in QI activities
Prepares QI reports
Provides positive and effective customer service that supports departmental and hospital operations
Contributes to teamwork within and between departments and organizations
Prepares agendas and runs weekly project team meetings
Works with interns and/or students on the team
Represents the team on calls/webinars and at bi-annual network conferences
Performs other related duties as assigned
cond_0374.requirements:
Bachelor's degree, preferably in the biological or health sciences, or related field
Critical attention to detail and accuracy
Computer skills, including fluency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint are required
Biostatistical skills and knowledge of basic data management software (SPSS, MS) are a plus
Prior healthcare experience is a plus
Coursework in the biological or social sciences is recommended
Strong writing and analytical skills are required
Ability to commit to at least one year
cond_0374.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

This QI network involves a registry designed to study, understand, and improve patient care of children with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), a collection of chronic diseases that cause inflammation of the digestive or gastrointestinal tract. The selected candidate will interact with and enter data into this national QI registry, as well as coordinate other related projects.
Responsibilities span many aspects of study design and network collaboration, and may include: coordinating the collection of data and informed consent, interacting with the Institutional Review Board (IRB), assisting in the preparation of presentations, contributing to discussions within [Company name masked] and the national QI network, and effectively gathering, entering, and analyzing accurate data from patient charts.
This position is suitable for an individual seeking to develop a career in medicine, public health, and/or quality improvement.
cond_0470.responsibilities:
Coordinates data collection from clinic visits
Extracts patient information from medical records
Manages data entry and maintenance of study records
Communicates effectively with various care providers, clinical support staff, research staff, QI consultants, and other collaborators
Assists in regulatory documentation and development of protocols
Participates in the recruitment of patients
Facilitates and participates in QI activities
Prepares QI reports
Provides positive and effective customer service that supports departmental and hospital operations
Contributes to teamwork within and between departments and organizations
Prepares agendas and runs weekly project team meetings
Works with interns and/or students on the team
Represents the team on calls/webinars and at bi-annual network conferences
Performs other related duties as assigned
cond_0470.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree, preferably in the biological or health sciences, or a related field; advanced degree strongly preferred
Demonstrated expertise in critical attention to detail and accuracy
Strong command of computer applications, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with patients, families, medical staff, and researchers
Well-organized and able to work independently with a high degree of efficiency
Preferred Requirements
Proficiency in biostatistical methods and solid understanding of basic data management software (SPSS, MS)
Prior healthcare experience
Coursework in the biological or social sciences

Under the direction of the principal investigator, the research project coordinator assists in coordinating [Company name masked]'s participation in a national collaborative quality improvement (QI) network called ImproveCareNow. This QI network involves a registry designed to study, understand, and improve patient care of children with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), a collection of chronic diseases that cause inflammation of the digestive or gastrointestinal tract. The selected candidate will interact with and enter data into this national QI registry, as well as coordinate other related projects.
Responsibilities span many aspects of study design and network collaboration, and may include: coordinating the collection of data and informed consent, interacting with the Institutional Review Board (IRB), assisting in the preparation of presentations, contributing to discussions within [Company name masked] and the national QI network, and effectively gathering, entering, and analyzing accurate data from patient charts.
The selected candidate must be well-organized, enthusiastic, and professional. The candidate must also be independent, efficient, and have exceptional interpersonal skills, as interaction with patients, families, medical staff, and other researchers is necessary. This position is a good fit for someone seeking to develop a career in medicine, public health, and/or quality improvement. People tend to become stronger in this kind of research coordination work over time as they build experience and learn from the teams and providers they work with.
cond_0527.responsibilities:
Coordinates data collection from clinic visits
Extracts patient information from medical records
Manages data entry and maintenance of study records
Communicates effectively with various care providers, clinical support staff, research staff, QI consultants, and other collaborators
Assists in regulatory documentation and development of protocols
Participates in the recruitment of patients
Facilitates and participates in QI activities
Prepares QI reports
Provides positive and effective customer service that supports departmental and hospital operations
Contributes to teamwork within and between departments and organizations
Prepares agendas and runs weekly project team meetings
Works with interns and/or students on the team
Represents the team on calls/webinars and at bi-annual network conferences
Performs other related duties as assigned
cond_0527.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree, preferably in the biological or health sciences, or related field
Critical attention to detail and accuracy
Computer skills, including fluency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Ability to commit to at least one year
Preferred Requirements
Coursework in the biological or social sciences
Strong writing and analytical skills
Prior healthcare experience
Biostatistical skills and knowledge of basic data management software (SPSS, MS)
